incident_text: Heavy smoke is rising behind a farm and a house stands close to the smoke. We think a wildfire is coming toward the house.

result.scene_summary: A large, dark, stormy cloud formation looms over a rural landscape with trees and houses in the foreground.

observations.description: Large plume of dark, dense smoke rising from the horizon, partially obscuring the sky.
Dark green forest line in the midground, with some scattered trees in the foreground.
Residential houses visible on the right side of the image, partially surrounded by trees.
The sky is filled with heavy, grey clouds, suggesting an impending storm or恶劣天气.

not_determinable: scale of fire or smoke plume
